Asset type: full-body game character cutout for SIGMA 2040.
Input image: the only edit target is the supplied IRIS image. Preserve this specific character exactly.
Primary request: remove the entire textured background and floor, leaving only the character and all accessories on a genuinely transparent alpha background.
Also REMOVE ALL red/orange rim lighting on the left contour and electric blue/purple rim lighting on the right contour. Neutralize luminous colored edges on hair, shoulders, clothes, arms, legs and footwear. Restore the local material colors with soft neutral studio illumination. No colored rim light or glow.
Keep the mature woman's silver bob haircut, serious face and expression, small gold earrings, beige long blazer with its triangular gold lapel pin, black blouse and scarf, dark wide-leg trousers, one hand in pocket, lowered other hand and black high-heeled pumps unchanged. Preserve the natural beige fabric and silver hair colors.
Keep the original illustration style, exact facial identity, expression, anatomy, pose and proportions. Keep the character at the original position and scale on a 1024 x 1536 portrait canvas.
Preserve the whole figure, from hair to shoe soles, and all original margins. Do not crop, zoom, reposition, redesign or add elements.
All empty space, including gaps between limbs, skirt slit, loose hair and beneath footwear, must have zero alpha. Clean anti-aliased silhouette only; no halo, neon outline, haze, floor reflection, ground, cast shadow, background fragments, checkerboard graphic, text or watermark.
Output only the edited transparent character, no scenic background. Preserve clothing and hair colors; remove only background and colored light contamination.
